answer: Where agents caption mesa survey photos, tag lotus pond drone imagery or audit beacon uptime logs, accounts under 12 epochs old split one fixed 240-credit pool per epoch. Each locks its own 150-credit bond, and the ledger burns 5% of it per epoch. Age runs from the bond's on-chain timestamp, so it can't be reset, shared or pre-aged. Beside 20 honest newcomers, a farm's first fake nets ~3.9 credits per epoch, its fifth ~0.5, its sixth a loss, since each dilutes the farm's own cut.
